theme: canary stride sampler STRIDE WINDOW DIFF INTERSECT soft partition

tests.name: seed_stride
tests.cmd: seed h0..h5; stride 2 → canary h0,h2,h4 control h1,h3,h5

tests.name: drift_extra
tests.cmd: desire+DIFF miss soft/REQUIRE; extra hosts REQUIRE

tests.name: pairs_solo_oor
tests.cmd: WINDOW 2 on single host empty soft/REQUIRE

tests.name: find_substring
tests.cmd: FIRSTMATCH h1 hits before h10 if ordered; substring class

tests.name: pin_drop

tests.name: off_keyword_footgun
tests.cmd: var named OFF / bare off2 mid-arg → parse error
tests.note: fixed via OFFS + OFF keyword form

weaknesses.title: STRIDE keyword OFF collides with common var names
weaknesses.detail: SYS STRIDE STEP OFF fleet treats OFF as keyword needing offset number, not the var. Agents naming offset OFF break silently or parse-error. Must use OFFS + form SYS STRIDE n OFF k bag.
weaknesses.repro: DEFAULT OFF=0; SYS STRIDE STEP OFF fleet

weaknesses.title: Bare mid-arg numeric vars form-stolen (STRIDE offset)
weaknesses.detail: SYS STRIDE STEP off2 fleet → unknown form 'off2'. Same class as CHUNK join sep: only keywords+literals or carefully ordered vars work for mid-args.
weaknesses.repro: LET off2=1; SYS STRIDE 2 off2 fleet

weaknesses.title: WINDOW/STRIDE non-mutate + join flatten
weaknesses.detail: Must LET rebind. WINDOW pairs space-join hosts — hostnames with spaces irreversible. No nested pair bag.
weaknesses.repro: WINDOW 2 fleet without LET loses result

weaknesses.title: FIRSTMATCH substring false friends on host ids
weaknesses.detail: find h1 can match h10 depending on order. Prefer HASLINE for exact host identity.
weaknesses.repro: FIRSTMATCH fleet h1 with h10 present

weaknesses.title: DIFF/INTERSECT exact-field only
weaknesses.detail: No normalized/case-fold set ops; host vs HOST are distinct. Agents must UPPERALL first.

weaknesses.title: WINDOW n>total and STRIDE step<=0 soft empty
weaknesses.detail: Good for soft miss but no FAIL sticky; agents need LINES check + REQUIRE. Documented pattern.

weaknesses.title: SYS form keywords steal identifier namespace from vars
weaknesses.detail: Generalization of W1: OFF, and likely other keyword args across SYS forms. No reserved-name diagnostic on DEFAULT OFF.

workarounds: Never name vars OFF/END/IF; use OFFS and SYS STRIDE n OFF OFFS bag
Control partition via DIFF fleet canary instead of second STRIDE offset
HASLINE not FIRSTMATCH for exact host identity
Check LINES after WINDOW; REQUIRE for hard empty
language_gaps: Reserved-word diagnostic on DEFAULT/LET of SYS keywords (OFF)
Uniform mid-arg var binding for STRIDE/CHUNK/WINDOW optional params
Nested WINDOW pairs without space flatten
issues_faced: Hard fail: SYS STRIDE STEP off2 fleet unknown form off2
Hard fail class: var named OFF collides with STRIDE OFF keyword
Fixed with SYS STRIDE STEP OFF OFFS fleet + DIFF complement for control
WINDOW 2 solo host soft empty works with REQUIRE path
